name: Hải Phòng
scopeLimits: This record covers source discovery only. The WUP point is a settlement centroid, not a parcel identity or municipal boundary. No full parcel geometry, owner data, address data, or credentials were retained.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: The official Hải Phòng IOC land-information dashboard reports city-wide land information, including attribute and spatial parcel counts, establishing local cadastral/land-information activity. The dashboard reports aggregate statistics rather than parcel features.

officialSources.observation: Official Hải Phòng IOC land-information dashboard; current page reports city-wide aggregate attribute/spatial parcel counts and commune-level statistics, not downloadable parcel features.
Official city planning-map portal reviewed as context; layers were not verified as a city cadastral parcel feature service.
